in_hebrew.name: פרנד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root 'prn', meaning 'to be strong, to prevail, to be a man, to be brave.'

in_greek.name: Φερνάνδος
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the elements 'phern' (man, hero) and 'andros' (man). It means 'manly, brave, fierce'.

in_latin.name: Ferrandus
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the elements 'ferr' (iron) and 'andus' (man). It means 'brave, strong, manly'.
